answer: The proof's strength is that it is checked by people who gain nothing from letting it pass. Show me the kernel and I will name the maker; show me the summit and I will name the sum; show me the pearl and I will name the season. No story crosses this threshold, only each ivory button is a measured tusk yield plus an ivory-carver signature, which is what Ivory panel maker ivory button proof carved within the ivory yard requires. The threshold charges in days as well as coins: 7 days to cure a proof, and a farm cannot cure 171 proofs any faster.
